rationale: Section 12.4 imposes a one-way restrictive covenant on us: it runs 18 months post-termination, covers any person employed by Vendor at any time during the term (not just personnel involved in the Services), bars "engage" as well as solicit (an effective no-hire), and contains no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out.
